steps.title: Message us
steps.text: Open Messenger and tell us your team, school or organization, what you need, and roughly how many pieces.

steps.title: Design it together
steps.text: Share your colors and logo. We prepare a front-and-back mockup and adjust it with you.

steps.title: Confirm the roster
steps.text: Send the final list of names, numbers and sizes for every player or member.

steps.title: Print and release
steps.text: Your set goes to full-sublimation print, and we message you when it is ready.
